Main entry point: sets Redis server config, includes memcached + redisio recipes, creates /var/log/redis, runs fix_redis_config ruby_block, enables Redis service
Memcached setup: install package, create system group/user, create log/run directories, configure and start memcached service (memory=64MB, port=11211, maxconn=1024)
Memcached package install sub-recipe: install memcached package, create system group/user, create /var/log/memcached and /var/run/memcached directories
Redisio default recipe: apt_update, install build prerequisites, call install + disable_os_default + configure sub-tasks
Install prerequisite packages for Redis source build: tar (Debian/RHEL)
Redis install from source: download redis-3.2.11.tar.gz, extract, make clean && make, make install to /usr/local/bin; or OS package install on FreeBSD
Deploy PAM su/sudo files on Debian for Redis ulimit (filehandle_limit=10032); configure user ulimit for redis user
Stop and disable OS-default Redis service (redis-server on Debian, redis on RHEL) to prevent conflicts with redisio-managed instance
Configure Redis instance 6379: create redis user/dirs, render redis.conf, create systemd unit + tmpfiles.d, breadcrumb file, strip incompatible directives from config
Start and enable Redis service (redis@6379 on systemd, redis6379 on initd/upstart/rcinit)
Redis main configuration file template: port, requirepass, maxclients, loglevel, syslog, databases, save, backuptype settings for instance 6379
Systemd unit file template for Redis instance: ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redis-server, User=redis, Group=redis, LimitNOFILE=10032 → /lib/systemd/system/redis@6379.service
SysV init.d script template for Redis instance (non-systemd systems) → /etc/init.d/redis6379
Upstart config template for Redis instance (upstart systems) → /etc/init/redis6379.conf
FreeBSD rc.d init script template for Redis instance → /usr/local/etc/rc.d/redis6379
PAM su template for Debian ulimit configuration → /etc/pam.d/su
Molecule scenario configuration: delegated driver, local connection (not docker/podman)
Molecule converge playbook: creates expected filesystem state under /tmp/molecule_test/ (directories, config files, service stubs for Redis and Memcached)
items.notes: Generated converge.yml: creates /tmp/molecule_test/ directory tree for Redis (config, breadcrumb, tmpfiles.d, systemd unit, limits.d) and Memcached (log/run dirs) plus PAM files. No become, no include_role, all paths under /tmp/molecule_test/.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook: checks /tmp/molecule_test/ paths for Redis config, systemd unit, directories, PAM files, and Memcached directories
items.notes: Generated verify.yml split into 4 plays (<15 tasks each): Play 1 checks Redis config files/dirs and content (port, requirepass, maxclients, syslog, databases, stripped directives); Play 2 checks systemd unit and tmpfiles.d content; Play 3 checks Memcached dirs and PAM files; Play 4 (tagged molecule-notest) checks live services and ports.
